question: The _______________ of the Indian Constitution defines the Fundamental Duties of Indian Citizens.
solution:
The correct answer is **Article 51A**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 51A** of the Indian Constitution outlines the Fundamental Duties of Indian citizens.
 
• These duties were added by the 42nd Amendment Act in 1976.
 
• The Fundamental Duties serve as a constant reminder to citizens to uphold the spirit of patriotism and to contribute to the nation's growth.
 
• There are currently 11 Fundamental Duties listed in Article 51A.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 Article 51A outlines the Fundamental Duties of Indian citizens.
 
 

 Option 2
 Article 41B does not exist in the Indian Constitution.
 
 

 Option 3
 Article 49C does not exist in the Indian Constitution.
 
 

 Option 4
 Article 21A deals with the Right to Education.
